subject: U-CHAIN round 2: NO-GO posted; evidence pushed
body: Aggregated all three round-2 axes and both held bots, posted review 5260110523 on PR #484 after the egress receipt, and pushed report-only evidence commit b431c4182efc555c5057e010b73933ca321ef05e to ravidsrk/u-chain with maintainer authorship and no trailers. The NO-GO preserves zero Critical, ten Required axis entries and VALID BOT-4/P1 plus BOT-5/P2; all 1707 tests, the final validator and the secret scan passed, and the pushed commit is code-identical with a clean worktree. The listed fixes and a new review remain before merge, while this verdict stays bound to reviewed SHA 302d43e9e028f93d0698bccaa93f308f1fdbdb63 and tree f66caa068a07d574be260054e51118413468cfbf because evidence files change the full tree.
